descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Your circuit. Your rules. Your race.

BUILD
Press Y to open the round build wheel. Pick a straight, a corner, a hairpin, an S-bend or a lane shift and aim it at the end of your road - it snaps on perfectly. Add a start grid and a start gantry, climb ramps up onto bridges and send the road over itself with an overpass. 24 road pieces in all, including big bumps and speed bumps.

RACE
Point at a car and press A. 3-2-1-GO, and the trigger is your gas pedal. Brake for the corners, climb over the flyover and hold your line against rival cars over 3, 5 or 10 laps, or race alone and set a track record. Take a corner too fast and you are off the track. Your lap, place and time are on your wrist.

THE SKY GARAGE
Build on a 60 metre floor in a penthouse motorsport club high above a sunny city: a glass wall onto the skyline, supercars on turntables, a pit stop cafe, a lounge with a giant screen, sim racing rigs, grandstands and a winners' podium.

MAKE IT YOURS
12 race car colors, grandstands, pit garages, banner towers, checkered flags, billboards and trees, and four circuit styles: grass, desert, snow and city.

Start from three ready-made circuits - Grand Prix, Speedway and Mountain Pass - or an empty floor. Undo, auto-save and music included.
